items.title: Special termination right before price increase takes effect
items.quote: Damit die Kündigung wirkt, muss sie bei uns vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen.
items.computation: The new prices take effect on 01.01.2027 ("Ihre Gaspreise ab 01.01.2027"). The letter grants a special, notice-period-free termination right effective 01.01.2027, but requires the cancellation to reach the provider BEFORE the new prices take effect, i.e. before 2027-01-01. The last calendar day before that is 2026-12-31. This is a contractual deadline set by the provider, not a statutory period under BGB/VwVfG, so no §193 BGB weekend/holiday extension applies; the cancellation must physically arrive by 31.12.2026.
